newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-Z wins DM 17 mln GM deal.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-Z wins DM 17 mln GM deal.

text.p: Polish construction firm Mostostal Zabrze SA won a 17 million mark General Motors Corp deal on construction works in its subsidiary Adam Opel AG's car factory in Gliwice, Mostostal said in a statement on Friday.
It said the works would be completed in October next year.
The 500 million mark Opel factory in Gliwice, southern Poland, is expected to employ 2,000 workers and to assemble about 72,000 medium-size passenger cars annually from 1998.
